description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling UI interactions in an OpenCart e-commerce project, including tooltips, observe mutations, button states, form submissions via AJAX, file uploads, autocomplete functionality, product display toggle, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: oc_tooltip
methods.description: Handles tooltip initialization and display on elements with Bootstrap tooltip.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Creates a jQuery plugin to observe DOM mutations on selected elements.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Extends jQuery to provide button state management ('loading' and 'reset') for button and link elements.

methods.name: Form submission handler
methods.description: Intercepts AJAX-enabled forms to submit data via AJAX, handle responses, show alerts, and update UI accordingly.

methods.name: Upload button handler
methods.description: Handles file uploads triggered via a button with data attributes, uploads files asynchronously, and displays success/error messages.

methods.name: Autocomplete plugin
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete dropdown, fetches suggestions asynchronously, and handles user selection.

methods.name: Product list/grid toggle
methods.description: Switches product display between list and grid view, saving preference in local storage.

methods.name: Modal information loader
methods.description: Loads content into a modal dynamically via AJAX when a modal link is clicked.
